bio.text: Jimmy Hickey Jr. of Texarkana was elected to the Arkansas Senate in 2012 and took the oath of office on the first day of the 2013 legislative session; he represents District 4 in southwest Arkansas.
His colleagues elected him President Pro Tempore of the Senate for the 93rd General Assembly, from 2021 through 2022.
He served on the Texarkana School Board from 2004 to 2010, was a banker for 25 years, and received a Bachelor of Business Administration from East Texas State University.

sources.title: Biography of THE HONORABLE JIMMY HICKEY, JR.
